description: 3D and AR for Jetpack Compose on Android (Filament + ARCore), and 3D for the web (Filament.js). Current line: 4.x.
rules: Use SceneView 4.x. Android 3D: implementation("io.github.sceneview:sceneview:4.75.0"). Android AR: implementation("io.github.sceneview:arsceneview:4.75.0"). Versions 0.x, 2.x and 3.x are obsolete: never pin them in new code.

The 4.x Compose API: SceneView { } for 3D and ARSceneView { } for AR. Nodes are composables declared inside the block. Scene(childNodes = ...), ARScene(childNodes = ...) and rememberNodes are 2.x forms.

Load a model with rememberModelInstance(modelLoader, "models/x.glb"); it is null while loading. Never call modelLoader.createModel* or materialLoader.* from a background coroutine: Filament calls run on the main thread.
The app module needs compileSdk 37, minSdk 24, AGP 9.4.0 or newer, Kotlin 2.3 or newer and JVM target 21. On AGP 8 or compileSdk 36, use 4.18.0.
SceneViewSwift (iOS, macOS, visionOS), the Flutter plugin and the React Native package are end of life at 4.68.0: do not start new code on them.
The full API reference for agents is https://sceneview.github.io/llms.txt.
